name: PhysicalProperties
description: Intermediate grouping node for the physical characteristics of a battery: mass, dimensions, rated capacity and operating temperature range. Acts as a container in the schema tree — child bricks supply the actual measured values.

leaf_properties.label: Notes
leaf_properties.description: Optional free-text notes on the physical characteristics of this battery.

metadata.note: Intermediate grouping brick. Schema edges connect: Mass, Dimensions, BatteryCapacity, Temperature (min and max).
